input_provenance.verification: Archive bytes unchanged; each CLI also validates member manifests and hashes the input archive before and after replay.

measurement_environment.cpu: Intel Xeon E5-2697 v2 KVM, 40 virtual CPUs, 64GB RAM
measurement_environment.affinity: CPU2 for comparisons; CPU2,3 for serial/multicore batch
measurement_environment.counters: Hardware perf user cycles/instructions and task-clock, enabled only inside measured scopes
measurement_environment.allocator: System wrapper; all Rust GlobalAlloc calls including mlua; direct native malloc excluded
measurement_environment.input: Retained complete captures compared uncompressed; song source and capture bytes unchanged
measurement_environment.scope: Production prepare_song_lua: context/timing included, initial note parsing and output hashing excluded. Fixture: complete CLI. Three interleaved pairs per primary workload, one supplemental heavy pair per workload with explicitly reused identical baseline.

normalization: Temporary extraction directories and process-specific addresses in typed actor/name/path handles; first-observation identities preserve aliases within each scene. All other report bytes, including field/event order, are exact.
Compiler hashes include complete compiled layer debug data without preparation times

sampling.primary: Three interleaved baseline/candidate pairs each for null/OpenGL production preparation and full VTubers replay; pair one runs baseline then candidate, pair two reverses order, pair three baseline then candidate
sampling.supplemental: One new after run each for full Mountain King and Mawaru7 diagnostic through-second30; reuses identical previous current-v3 baseline samples with explicit binary/source/input provenance
sampling.multicore: One serial/two-worker pair on the updated runner; capability existed before this pass and is not counted as a new optimization
